start_welcome: Hi! I'm the EDU bot for parents and teachers 🦏 Here you sign up, register your child and get their progress, evening quiz results and graded work. Who are you?
student_home:
Hi, student! 📘
Didn't get a topic in class? Let's figure it out together.
student_home_consent_wait: ⚠️ Waiting for your parent's consent — the bot can't explain topics without it.
teacher_home:
Teacher menu 👩‍🏫
See your students' stats: /class
Results by topic: /journal
choose_language:
Choose a language 👇
It's shared by the bot, the site and explanations.
not_student: First choose the “Student” role in the menu.
consent_required: Your parent hasn't given consent for data processing yet. Ask mom or dad to open the parent menu and tap “Data processing” → “I agree”.
ask_topic:
Tell me what you didn't get 👇

Type the topic (for example: “fractions”, “area of a triangle”) or send a photo of the task.
thinking: Great question! Thinking about how to explain… ⏳
limit_reached:
That's all the explanations for today ({limit}). 🔒
Come back tomorrow — I'm here to help!
generation_failed:
Hmm, I couldn't figure out the task. 😔
Try wording the topic differently or send the photo again.
need_text_or_photo: Please send the topic as text or a photo of the task.
topic_too_long: That topic is too long. Write it shorter (one sentence) or send a photo.
spam_slow: Please slow down a little 🙏 Wait a couple of seconds.
blocked_banner:
⛔ Your account is blocked in this bot.
If you think this is a mistake, contact the administrator.
owner_only: ⛔ No access — this command is for the owner only.
owner_not_configured: The owner isn't set up. Find your ID with /myid, add OWNER_ID to .env and restart the bot.
stale_step: You've already moved ahead (for example, on the site). Here's the current step 👇
cancel_done: Topic paused ⏸ Continue anytime — here or on the site.
ask_parent_code: Enter your child's 6-digit code (the student sees it in /profile).
code_invalid: The code has 6 digits. Please try again.
code_not_found: No student with this code. Check the code and try again.
already_linked: This student is already linked to your account.
consent_intro:
Student data processing 🔎

A parent's consent is needed before using the platform. We only store the child's progress, points and topics. Photos of tasks are not kept. See the policy — button below.
consent_need_bind_first: First link your child by code — then you can give consent.
consent_done: Consent confirmed! The student can use the bot and the site. 🤗
parent_topic_done:
🎉 {name} finished the topic “{title}”!
⭐ +{earned} points{where}. Give some praise — it really matters 💛
teacher_topic_done:
📘 Student {name} finished the topic “{title}”{where}.
❓ Questions: {steps}
⭐ +{earned} points

📒 All results: /journal
journal_more_students: …and {n} more students. See the full list in the journal on the site.
journal_no_entries: No finished topics yet. As soon as the student finishes one, the result will show up here.
journal_forbidden: The journal is for parents and teachers.
support_ask: 💬 Support Describe your question or problem in one message — you can attach a screenshot (put the text in its caption). The answer will come here, in the bot.
support_need_text: Please write your question as text (for a screenshot — in the caption).
support_too_long: The message is too long — please keep it under 2000 characters.
support_sent: ✅ Request #{id} sent. The answer will come here, in the bot.
support_limit: You've already sent {limit} requests in the last 24 hours. Please wait for an answer — we'll definitely reply.
support_unavailable: Support isn't set up yet. Please try later.
support_only_adults: Support is for parents and teachers. If something doesn't work, ask your mom, dad or teacher for help 🙂
support_owner_ask_reply: Write your reply to request #{id} in one message:
support_reply_failed: ⚠️ Reply to #{id} was saved but not delivered: the user is unavailable (they may have stopped the bot).
work_graded_parent: 📝 The teacher has checked the work “{title}”. 👤 {name}: {score} of {max}{comment}
work_graded_student: 📝 Your work “{title}” has been checked: {score} of {max}{comment}
evening_reminder: 🌙 Your evening quiz is ready — just 2 minutes. Shall we check what clicked today? Mistakes are okay 🙂
evening_done_parent: 🌙 {name} understood {understood} of {total} topics today. Weak topic: {weak} — you can review it together or send a task from the report.
evening_done_parent_all: 🌙 {name} understood {understood} of {total} topics today. Great evening! 💛
assignment_new: 📌 {who} sent you a task: {topic}{note} Open “I don't get it” — we'll work through it together.
push_evening_weak: Weak topic: {topic}. You can send a task from the report.
push_check_body: Grades are waiting for your confirmation
push_test_body: This is how EDU reminders and news will look.
support_reply_site: ✅ Reply to #{id} saved. The author has no Telegram — they'll see the reply on the site under “Support”.
weblogin_confirm: 🔐 Site login Tap the number shown on the site right now 👇 ⚠️ If you aren't logging in to the site right now, tap “Not me” and don't forward this link to anyone.
weblogin_confirmed: ✅ Login confirmed! Go back to the site — it will open by itself.
weblogin_wrong_code: ❌ The number didn't match — login cancelled. If it was you, start logging in on the site again.
weblogin_rejected: 👍 Login cancelled. Nobody got into your account.
weblogin_expired: ⌛ This login link has expired or was already used. Start logging in on the site again.
weblogin_not_mentor: 🚫 This login is for mentors, and your account has a different role. Use the regular login page on the site.
name_required: Please type the name as text.
access_regenerated: New code for {name}: 👤 Login: {login} 🔢 Code: {code} The old code no longer works.
ask_teacher_code: Enter the student's 6-digit code to link them.
class_empty:
No students in your class yet. 🔗
Ask a student to show the code from /profile and link them.
profile_parent_empty: No linked children yet. Add one with the code from the child's profile.
profile_teacher:
You're a teacher 👩‍🏫
Manage students with /class.
weekly_praise_0: It's okay — sometimes a break is needed. What matters is that you're there.
weekly_praise_1: A good start! Moving forward bit by bit. 🌱
nudge_text:
💛 {name} hasn't been here for a few days. That's normal — kids get tired sometimes.

A simple idea: offer to study together for just 10 minutes and finish one small topic. Interest comes back faster than you think. There's no rush.
correct_no_points: ✅ Correct! Points are given for answers on the first or second try — you'll get it next time 💪
simplify_limit: I've already made this step simpler several times. Read it carefully once more and try to answer — or ask your teacher 🙂
report_thanks: Thank you! 🙏 I've passed it to the teacher — we'll check this step.
report_already: You've already reported a mistake in this step — thanks!
delete_confirm: Delete ALL data of “{name}”: account, points, topics, links? This can't be undone.
delete_done: The data of “{name}” has been deleted. Only a note that you deleted it remains in the log.
lesson_header: 📖 Let me explain: {title} Read carefully — questions come next 👇
review_wrong: ❌ Not quite. Let's look at why 👇
start_kid_hint:
🎒 Are you a student? Learning happens in the EDU app: {site}
Your parent or teacher will give you a login and code.
role_student_moved: Students learn in the EDU app — a parent or teacher gives them access.
reg_ask_name: What should we call you? Type your first and last name.
reg_bad_name: The name should be 2 to 60 characters of plain text.
reg_ask_phone:
📱 Share your phone number — you'll use it to sign in on the website by SMS to this same account and to add a second parent.

Tap the button below 👇
reg_phone_not_own: We need your own number — tap «📱 Share my number».
reg_phone_not_uz: For now we only accept Uzbekistan numbers (+998). You can skip this step.
reg_phone_taken: This number is already linked to another account. Sign in on the website by SMS or skip this step.
reg_done_parent: Done, {name}! 🎉 You're registered as a parent.
reg_done_teacher: Done, {name}! 🎉 You're registered as a teacher.
reg_child_ask_name: What's your child's name? First name (and last name if you like).
reg_bad_grade: Pick the grade with a button.
reg_consent:
Last step 🔒

For {name} to start learning we need your consent to process the child's data: name, grade, answers and progress. The data is never shared with third parties and you can delete it any time in the profile.

Privacy policy, version {version}.
reg_child_done: 🎉 {name} is registered! Sign-in to the EDU app: 🌐 {site} 👤 Login: {login} 🔢 Code: {code} How to start: 1. Open the link on your child's phone or tablet. 2. «Sign in with login» → login and code. 3. «Add to Home Screen» and turn on notifications in the profile — the app will remind about the evening quiz. Save the code — I show it only once. A new code is in «Profile».
reg_student_done: 🎉 {name} is added! Sign-in to the EDU app: 🌐 {site} 👤 Login: {login} 🔢 Code: {code} Give these to the student. To start learning a parent's consent is needed: the parent signs up in this bot and links the child with code {family_code}.
family_full_children: The family already has the maximum number of children.
evening_missed_parent:
🌙 {name} hasn't done today's evening quiz yet — it's only 2 minutes.

A gentle reminder can help. No pressure: missing a day is fine, streak freezes will save the streak 🙂
push_evening_missed_title: 🌙 {name} hasn't done the evening quiz yet
push_evening_missed_body: Only 2 minutes. A gentle reminder can help — no pressure 🙂
reg_next_parent: Now register your child: they'll learn in the EDU app and you'll get their progress here.
reg_next_teacher: Add your students: each gets access to the EDU app, and you get class stats and work checking.
